summary: Braemar Hotels & Resorts filed an 8-K disclosing that indirect subsidiaries BHR Scottsdale LP, BHR Scottsdale Storage LLC and BHR TRS Scottsdale LLC entered an Agreement of Purchase and Sale on September 23, 2026 with Evergreen Acquisitions, LLC, an unaffiliated Delaware buyer, to sell the Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale at Troon North for $372 million, subject to customary prorations. A $10 million deposit became non-refundable at signing. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing date was disclosed. Conditions remain, so completion and timing are uncertain. Watch closing conditions and any REIT capital-recycling use of proceeds, including debt paydown or buybacks.
